components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a view, such as flipping the card.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:48px; padding:0 0.8rem; border:3px solid #000; border-radius:12px; background:var(--paper, #D5F1F7); color:#000; font-family:'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-stretch:87.5%; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .18s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(2px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #000; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#000; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ink, #064B5E); }

components.name: Tile
components.description: One square of the bingo grid: label, character, label, and a stamp when marked.
components.css: .ds-tile { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto; justify-items:center; align-items:center; width:72px; height:72px; padding:5px 2px; border:0; background:var(--paper, #D5F1F7); color:var(--ink, #064B5E); font-family:'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-stretch:75%; font-weight:600; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tile:hover { transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #000; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-stamp { position:absolute; inset:15%; color:var(--stamp, #E8344A); mix-blend-mode:multiply; transform:rotate(-11deg); }

components.name: Season Switch
components.description: Four outlined swatches; the active season is larger.
components.css: .ds-seasons { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; } .ds-seasons span { display:block; width:16px; height:16px; border:3px solid #000; border-radius:50%; } .ds-seasons .ds-on { width:26px; height:26px; }

narrative.overview: The whole product is a single physical card. The front is a printed bingo board in the season's colour that you mark with a rubber stamp. The back is your trading card: a character, a badge, stars, stat boxes and a card number. Everything else on screen is a quiet label next to that object.
keyCharacteristics: Flat colour and black outline carry everything. There are no shadows and no blur.
The board and the scorecard share one 5:7 footprint and flip into each other.
Illustration is geometric: circles, rounded rectangles, dot eyes.
Stamps are the only thing allowed to sit crooked.

rules.name: The Re-ink Rule
rules.body: A component never names a season's hex. It uses the role (board, paper, ink, stamp) and the calendar does the rest.

rules.name: The AA Rule
rules.body: Board ink on board and ink on paper hold at least 4.5:1 in every season. The spec's named dominants (#FF4757, #00B4D8) are too light for that, so they are deepened on the board and kept as the small accent.

rules.name: The Card Scale Rule
rules.body: Type printed on the card is sized in container units against the card face, so the card scales as one object from a phone to a desktop.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it an outline or a fill, never a shadow.

dos: Do use season roles (bg-board, text-ink, bg-paper) instead of fixed hex values.
Do outline every surface in 3px black and every illustration in one stroke weight.
Do draw new characters from circles and rounded rectangles with dot eyes, on a 48x48 grid.
Do size anything printed on the card in cqw.
Do check both lettering pairs for 4.5:1 when adding a season.
donts: Don't add shadows, blur or gradients to interface surfaces. Gradients belong only to the sky behind an avatar.
Don't round the tiles or loosen the 2px grid.
Don't use emoji or an icon font; icons are drawn in the same round stroke.
Don't put a second primary button in one view.
